title: Heartopia
provenance: Reported by myzenon (highball-db#155, 2026-09-20): rated 4, playable with minor issues, Apple M4 Pro, macOS 27.0, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r5, Highball 0.9.28; graphics mode not stated. Not run here.
notes: Reported playable at 120 fps, about 100 on the 2K highest preset, on an M4 Pro with macOS 27. One issue reported: after switching to another window and back, the game has focus but takes no clicks or keyboard input until it is closed and started again.

knownIssues.symptom: After switching to another app and back, the game window has focus but ignores the mouse and keyboard until the game is restarted
knownIssues.fix: None known yet. Avoid switching away mid-session, or restart the game when it happens.
